Madras High Court Criticizes Civic Body Over Infrastructure

The Madras High Court has criticized the Greater Chennai Corporation for failing to improve infrastructure such as roads and footpaths, despite a continuous rise in property taxes and other charges. The court observed that the quality of civic infrastructure has not kept pace with the increasing financial burden on citizens.
